Recent outpatient visits included routine ophthalmologic cataract screening and endocrinology thyroid evaluation. Surgical background encompasses a 2015 laparoscopic cholecystectomy and a right knee arthroscopy performed ten years prior, both resolved without complication. He stopped smoking in 2017 after accumulating 38 pack-years.

Digital rectal examination remains normal; the prostate measures symmetrically enlarged with smooth, homogeneous consistency and no palpable nodules or asymmetries. Vital signs remain stable: blood pressure registers at 128/80 mmHg and heart rate holds steady at 57 beats per minute. Abdominal palpation and systemic review uncover no lymphadenopathy or masses.
